name: rmsnorm_bf16_h2048_automodel_torch_fp32
author: nemo-automodel
description: The shipped NeMo Automodel baseline: Float32RMSNorm, i.e. the nemo_automodel::float32_rms_norm custom op behind torch.compile(dynamic=True). This is what rms_norm: torch_fp32 runs today, so it is the number a winning kernel has to beat. The fp32 math and the store into y are compiled together so the destination-passing ABI does not add a second pass that the real Automodel path does not pay.
